purpose: Additional PM project detection, separate from both evaluation datasets

entries: Unloaded standard duct banks at the west gate.

At north trench station 2+40, continuous rock exposed at 4 feet below grade. Excavator production stopped. Protected the cut and requested a hydraulic breaker pending engineer review. Crew began tracking affected quantities and idle time.

register: IMG-141: continuous rock in the exposed north trench
IMG-142: depth rod shows rock at 4 feet, station 2+40
IMG-143: excavator bucket at the rock face
data.availability: Register only; original image files are not included in these synthetic inputs.

data.question: Please review the rock at station 2+40 against the contract investigation.
data.baselineExcerpt: Contract boring B-03 indicates granular fill and sandy clay through 8 feet, with no rock or refusal at the planned utility trench depth.
data.response: Station 2+40 is within the B-03 investigation area. The field rock differs from the indicated subsurface profile. Maintain protection, document quantities and seek PM direction before disturbing the condition further.

entries: Overnight dock access maintained for deliveries.

Avery Chen, the authorized owner representative identified in the contract directory, requested six additional protective bollards at dock doors 3–5. Jordan and I checked issued plan S-22: it contains no bollards at those doors. Marked six positions for review; installation awaits PM release.

data.item4: Owner requests six new bollards at dock doors 3–5 beyond the issued S-22 scope. Original tender schedule has no bollards at these doors. Avery confirmed authority, signed this direction, and acknowledged contractor receipt at 01:43. Existing dock protection elsewhere is unchanged.

data.body: Jordan, confirming my signed direction during our site walk for six additional bollards at dock doors 3–5. They are outside original S-22 and the tender quantity schedule we reviewed together. Please submit the additional installation cost and notice for PM/owner review before release. My owner representative authority is unchanged. — Avery

data.originalIssue: E-201 original contract issue: 42 chargers including east bay positions 41 and 42.
revisionNotes: Rev F deletes east bay positions 41 and 42. Revised total: 40 chargers.
Owner-approved scope reduction; no replacement chargers or offsetting work. Coordinate remaining circuits with panel schedule.

data.body: The purchase order acknowledgment still shows 42 chargers. Rev F has been approved and issued to reduce the original 42 to 40. The two omitted east bay chargers have not been installed. We have asked the supplier to confirm the reduced procurement quantity and cancellation terms before recognizing any credit.
